method: MCP Perfetto load_trace then execute_sql on 16 canonical plain JSON files; direct raw import, no normalization. String table encodes every repeated string cell as {$s:index}. Durations are ms. Sums may overlap and must not be added as elapsed latency.

sql.census: SELECT category,count(*) AS n,sum(dur)/1e6 AS summed_duration_ms FROM slice GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
sql.stages: SELECT name,count(*) AS n,sum(dur)/1e6 AS host_span_ms FROM slice WHERE category='user_annotation' AND name GLOB 'components::*' GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
sql.device: SELECT name,count(*) AS n,sum(dur)/1e6 AS kernel_sum_ms FROM slice WHERE category='kernel' GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
sql.attribution: SELECT st.name AS stage, b.category AS device_category, b.name AS device_name,count(DISTINCT b.id) AS n,sum(b.dur)/1e6 AS duration_sum_ms FROM flow f JOIN slice a ON a.id=f.slice_out JOIN slice b ON b.id=f.slice_in JOIN slice st ON st.track_id=a.track_id AND a.ts>=st.ts AND a.ts<st.ts+st.dur WHERE st.category='user_annotation' AND st.name GLOB 'components::*' AND b.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
sql.flow: SELECT a.category AS source_category,b.category AS destination_category,count(*) AS n FROM flow f JOIN slice a ON a.id=f.slice_out JOIN slice b ON b.id=f.slice_in GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
sql.waits: SELECT st.name AS stage,a.name,count(*) AS n,sum(a.dur)/1e6 AS host_wait_ms FROM slice a JOIN slice st ON st.track_id=a.track_id AND a.ts>=st.ts AND a.ts<st.ts+st.dur WHERE st.category='user_annotation' AND st.name GLOB 'components::*' AND a.category='cuda_runtime' AND (a.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' OR a.name GLOB '*Memcpy*') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
sql.device_scopes: WITH dev AS (SELECT ts,ts+dur AS te,dur,category,name FROM slice WHERE category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') AND dur>0), ordered AS (SELECT *,max(te) OVER (ORDER BY ts,te ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_end FROM dev), islands AS (SELECT *,sum(CASE WHEN prior_end IS NULL OR ts>prior_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY ts,te) AS grp FROM ordered), ranges AS (SELECT min(ts) AS lo,max(te) AS hi FROM islands GROUP BY grp) SELECT (SELECT sum(hi-lo)/1e6 FROM ranges) AS all_device_interval_union_ms,(SELECT (max(te)-min(ts))/1e6 FROM dev) AS device_span_ms,(SELECT sum(dur)/1e6 FROM dev WHERE category='kernel' AND name NOT GLOB 'nccl*') AS non_nccl_kernel_sum_ms,(SELECT sum(dur)/1e6 FROM dev WHERE category='kernel' AND name GLOB 'nccl*') AS nccl_kernel_sum_ms,(SELECT sum(dur)/1e6 FROM dev WHERE category='gpu_memcpy') AS memcpy_sum_ms,(SELECT sum(dur)/1e6 FROM dev WHERE category='gpu_memset') AS memset_sum_ms
